notes: בְּתֹם → *uprightly* is a rule 30/40 fusion of preposition and noun; the separately segmented article carries no sense the adverb writes and is `unrepresented`, exactly as the article of דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים → *chronicles* is.
בֶּטַח → *surely* is the adverbial accusative's own rendering (rule 33).
